claims: Kennesaw State University is an R2 public research university in Georgia.
Kennesaw State University has over 51,000 students across campuses in Kennesaw and Marietta.
Kennesaw State University offers over 190 academic programs.
Kennesaw State University offers over 190 undergraduate and graduate degrees.
Kennesaw State University offers engineering programs.
Kennesaw State University offers nursing programs.
Kennesaw State University offers business programs.
Kennesaw State University is designated as a Carnegie R2 doctoral research institution.
Kennesaw State University has a ~69% acceptance rate.
Kennesaw State University has a 3.2+ GPA requirement for test-optional admission through summer 2026.
Kennesaw State University competes as the Kennesaw State Owls in NCAA Division I Conference USA.
Kennesaw State University features over 100 student organizations.
Kennesaw State University has Greek life.
Kennesaw State University has the Marching Owls.
Kennesaw (main) and Marietta.
The Kennesaw campus of Kennesaw State University features a student center.
The Kennesaw campus of Kennesaw State University features green spaces.
The Kennesaw campus of Kennesaw State University has a University Green.
The Marietta campus of Kennesaw State University is home to the College of Architecture and Engineering.
The Marietta campus of Kennesaw State University was formerly Southern Polytechnic State University.
